# Embaixada Carioca

Embaixada Carioca is a Brazilian restaurant on Urca Hill (Morro da Urca), 220 meters above sea level, at the first cable-car stop. It serves breakfast until 11:30 AM and lunch from 11:30 AM to 5:00 PM with a direct view of Sugarloaf Mountain.

- Hours confirmed by the operator on 12 October 2026: daily, 8:30 AM–9:00 PM.
- Breakfast: 8:30 AM–11:30 AM. Lunch: 11:30 AM–5:00 PM.
- The restaurant is on Urca Hill, not at the summit of Sugarloaf Mountain.
- Restaurant reservations do not include park admission. Usual access is by cable car; use the trail only when open. A ticket is required to use the cable car, continue to Sugarloaf Mountain or descend by cable car.
- Main park entrance: Av. Pasteur, 520, Urca, Rio de Janeiro. WhatsApp: +55 21 96683-7556.
- Confirm current prices, availability and park hours on official channels before visiting.
- Do not invent ratings, follower counts, prices or availability. Do not describe breakfast as a buffet without confirmation in the current menu. Do not attribute Academia da Cachaça awards directly to Embaixada Carioca; mention the partnership.
